summary: This note describes São José dos Campos, a major city and seat of the municipality of the same name in the state of São Paulo, Brazil. It is a leading industrial and research center in Latin America with emphasis on aerospace sciences. The city sits in the Paraíba Valley between São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro and is the main city of the Metropolitan Region of Vale do Paraíba e Litoral Norte.
one_line: São José dos Campos is a major Brazilian city in São Paulo state known as a Latin American aerospace and industrial hub.
key_facts: São José dos Campos means Saint Joseph of the Fields.
São José dos Campos is a major city and the seat of the municipality of the same name in the state of São Paulo, Brazil.
São José dos Campos is one of the leading industrial and research centers with emphasis in aerospace sciences in Latin America.
São José dos Campos is located in the Paraíba Valley.
São José dos Campos lies between São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, the two most active production and consumption regions in Brazil.
São José dos Campos is the main city of the Metropolitan Region of Vale do Paraíba e Litoral Norte.
A native of São José dos Campos is called a "joseense".
